name: zai-coding
description: The owner's z.ai GLM coding-plan subscription, over its OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The path is what makes it the plan: /api/coding/paas/v4 bills the coding subscription, and z.ai's general endpoint at https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4 is NOT this one — it refuses the same token with "Insufficient balance or no resource package" because it bills a prepaid resource package instead. Pointing this file at the general URL would be a metered endpoint wearing a `subscription` posture, which is the one mislabelling the spend gate cannot survive. Model ids here are the plan's own (`glm-5.3`), not OpenRouter's (`z-ai/glm-5.3`), which is why this endpoint's models get their own files.
